java.methodology: Fresh independent javac --release8 attribution of all42sources, errors0. Source-first+index-first exact-position matching for declarations/calls/import/new and declared type expressions; source static qualifier and annotation rows additionally checked beyond old regression fixtures. Source positions are one-based and inclusive. Method target comparison allows erased varargs normalization only.

jsp.methodology: Independent character scanner (not Leflect parser); source first, matched every original opening tag, attribute, EL, comment, directive in both raw and semantic trees. Only root.children/attributeNodes traversed; sourceTag metadata copies excluded.
coverageLimitations: Lexical/structural source correspondence is exhaustive; runtime values are not asserted.
Classpath JSTL TLDs omitted by current autoLoad configuration;40fn calls and178JSTL handlers retain semantic syntax but no library target connection.
